verdict.rationale: GA4 documents programmatic access to report data through the Data API, names building custom dashboards as a use case, and has an official MCP server, so an agent can pull key metrics. Nothing shows an API or MCP tool that creates or saves a dashboard inside GA4 itself; the agent would have to assemble the dashboard outside the product. missing for 10: API/MCP endpoints to create or persist dashboards/reports within GA4, documentation of what the MCP server's tools can do, hands-on corroboration of an agent building a dashboard end-to-end.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent build a dashboard of my key metrics end-to-end via the API or MCP server

citations.quote: You can use the Data API to programmatically access Google Analytics report data.
Build custom dashboards to display Google Analytics data.
Try the MCP server for Google Analytics. Install from GitHub, and see the announcement for more details.
